_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every product claim used in Etsy copy, portfolio copy, blog copy, and marketing assets. Verified directly against the merged website implementation, not from marketing drafts.
_meta.verification_method: Direct source-code inspection of the merged repo at commit 2d72399, plus prior live-browser testing with chrome-devtools MCP tools in the build session (Lighthouse 100/100/100/100, 25/25 unit tests, all planner edge cases exercised)
_meta.cross_referenced_against: handoff/grok/BUILD-FACTS-TO-VERIFY.md (checklist authored by agent/grok-commerce before the build was final)

product_type: Digital download — static HTML/CSS/JavaScript website template (no backend, no build step required to run)
target_customer: Building contractors, renovation contractors, construction companies, extension specialists, paving companies, boundary-wall contractors, project managers, local building businesses
website_framework: Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and plain (unbundled, ES5-compatible) JavaScript. No React/Vue/Next.js/build tooling. Google Fonts (Inter, Fraunces) loaded from Google's CDN via <link> tags — the only external network dependency at page load.
supported_browsers: Any modern evergreen browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) supporting CSS custom properties, CSS Grid, and ES5 JavaScript. No polyfills included; not tested against Internet Explorer.

responsive_behaviour.evidence: CSS Grid/Flexbox layouts with breakpoints at 900px and 700px; live-tested at a 390px mobile viewport with chrome-devtools MCP — zero horizontal overflow after a fix (see known_issues_fixed).

mobile_navigation.type: Hamburger toggle button opening a fixed off-canvas panel with all nav links, theme picker, and the primary CTA
mobile_navigation.known_issue_fixed_during_build: A backdrop-filter on the sticky header created a new CSS containing block for the fixed-position menu, collapsing it to ~48px tall. Fixed by moving the blur to a ::before pseudo-element. Verified visually and via getBoundingClientRect() before/after.

configuration_system.description: A single JS file assigning window.SITE_CONFIG. Business identity, contact details, hours, service areas, services, project types, testimonials, FAQs, gallery, team, social links, map embed URL, three theme colour palettes, and every Renovation Scope & Budget Planner rate/multiplier/currency/disclaimer live here. No edits to index.html, style.css, app.js, or planner.js are required for ordinary rebranding.

themes.mechanism: CSS custom properties swapped at runtime by app.js based on site-config.js's themes object and activeTheme key; user's choice persists in localStorage (key: ssb-theme) but is not required — a default renders on first load.

planner.name: Renovation Scope & Budget Planner
planner.architecture: planner.js is a pure calculation module (no DOM access) shared between the browser (via app.js) and the automated test suite (via Node's require()). This is why its 25 unit tests can run without a browser.
inputs: length & width (m) or total floor area (m²)
8 trade checkboxes (demolition, structural alterations, plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, roofing, painting, flooring)
outputs: measured project area (or linear metres for boundary walls)
configurable budget range (min–max, with contingency % on the upper figure)
trade checklist (project-type defaults merged with explicit selections)
photo checklist for the site visit (varies by project type)
planner.step_count: Not a multi-step wizard — a single form organised into 4 fieldsets (Project Basics, Scope of Work, Site & Timing, Your Contact Details), submitted once to reveal the results panel.
planner.currency_default: ZAR (R), en-ZA locale — configurable in site-config.js under planner.currency
planner.disclaimer_text_present: Both inline in the planner section (links to disclaimer.html) and in the generated summary text itself: 'This is a preliminary, non-binding estimate only...'

budget_estimate_behaviour.calculation: quantity (area or linear metres) × configurable rate band × finish multiplier, adjusted by trade-selection add-on percentages and a complexity multiplier (site access × storeys × occupancy), then a contingency percentage is added to the upper bound only. Both bounds are rounded to the nearest configured increment.
budget_estimate_behaviour.guards_verified_by_test: Never returns NaN, Infinity, or a negative figure — asserted directly across a sweep of zero/negative/huge/tiny inputs in tests/planner.test.js. Missing or unusable dimensions return a computable:false state with a human-readable reason instead of a zero/garbage number.

disabled_budget_mode.mechanism: Setting planner.budgetEnabled to false in site-config.js. Verified by unit test: the tool still returns a full scope, trade checklist, assumptions, and photo checklist, but the budget section states plainly that estimates are disabled and to contact the business for a custom quotation — no numeric figures are shown or fabricated.

whatsapp_handoff.behaviour: Opens a pre-filled wa.me link in a new tab (window.open). This is a link the visitor must click — it does NOT send a message automatically or in the background. For the Planner and quote-form flows specifically, the exact message text is shown in an explicit confirmation modal (role=dialog) first; the wa.me tab only opens after the visitor clicks 'Confirm & Send'. Verified live by patching window.open and asserting it is not called until the confirm click.
whatsapp_handoff.do_not_claim: Do not say WhatsApp messages are sent automatically, or that the site has WhatsApp Business API integration — it does not. It only opens a prefilled WhatsApp web/app link.

email_handoff.behaviour: Opens the visitor's own email client via a mailto: link with pre-filled subject and body (URL-encoded, verified by unit test). Requires the visitor to have an email client configured — the site does not send email itself and has no backend/email server.
email_handoff.do_not_claim: Do not say the site sends emails or stores submissions — there is no backend.

print_behaviour.mechanism: A 'Print Summary' button adds a temporary body class that (via a @media print stylesheet) hides everything except the planner's summary block, then calls window.print().

download_behaviour.mechanism: A 'Download Summary' button creates a Blob from the plain-text summary and triggers a client-side file download (.txt) via a temporary <a download> element. No server involved.

local_data_behaviour.what_is_stored: Only the visitor's selected colour theme, in localStorage under the key ssb-theme.
local_data_behaviour.what_is_not_stored: Planner form inputs and quote-form inputs are NOT persisted anywhere — they exist only in page memory until the visitor navigates away or reloads. There is no database, no backend, and no analytics/tracking script by default.
local_data_behaviour.do_not_claim: Do not say the planner or quote form 'saves your progress' or 'remembers your project' across visits — it does not, beyond the theme choice.

quote_form.validation: Inline client-side validation (name required, phone-or-email format check, project type required) before the same explicit-confirm-then-WhatsApp flow as the Planner.
quote_form.do_not_claim: Do not say the quote form 'submits' or 'stores' data on a server — it only assembles a WhatsApp message that the visitor must confirm and send themselves.

planner_form.validation: Project type is required before calculation; all other fields are optional and missing ones are surfaced in the 'Missing Information' output list rather than blocking submission.

storage_behaviour: No database, no backend server, no CMS. This is a fully static site suitable for any static host (GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel static, S3, or a shared-hosting file upload).

deployment_requirements.requirements: Any static file host. No build step, no environment variables, no server-side runtime required. Buyer needs only to edit site-config.js and upload the files.
deployment_requirements.note_for_listing_copy: Do not claim hosting or a domain name is included in the purchase — it is not. The buyer supplies their own hosting/domain.

buyer_requirements: Basic comfort editing a JavaScript object literal in a text editor (site-config.js) and uploading files to a static host. No coding framework knowledge required for ordinary rebranding; light HTML/CSS familiarity helpful only for structural changes.

included_files.buyer_zip_contents: Defined in Phase 7 (seller-pack/buyer-files) — excludes .git, tests/, handoff/, scripts/release/, and any internal campaign/marketing planning documents.

support_boundaries: Not yet finalised in this document — set in the buyer LICENSE/support policy during Phase 7. Do not promise ongoing free customisation support, guaranteed response times, or unlimited revisions unless that policy is actually written and included in the buyer package.
demo_url_status: Not yet deployed to this URL as of writing this document (Phase 5 pending) — the release branch exists locally with the corrected canonical/OG/sitemap URLs, but main has not been updated yet.
disclaimers_present: Footer disclaimer on every page: all business names, contact details, ratings, statistics, testimonials, team profiles, licence and insurance statements are fictional sample content
Estimate Disclaimer page (disclaimer.html): preliminary, non-binding estimate; site inspection may be required; not a quotation or contract
Gallery cards individually labelled 'Replace with a real project photo' — not presented as real completed jobs
Legal callouts on Privacy and Terms pages stating they are starting-point templates, not legal advice
unsupported_claims_removed_from_original: A hardcoded real WhatsApp number embedded with an unrelated web-developer sales pitch ('im interested in the website Civic Core Construction')

test_results.unit_tests: 25/25 passing — node --test tests/planner.test.js (area calculation, budget ranges, finish multipliers, invalid/zero/negative inputs never producing NaN/Infinity/negative output, summary generation, WhatsApp/email URL encoding, reset, disabled-budget mode)
test_results.html_lint: htmlhint against all 5 HTML pages — 0 errors
test_results.lighthouse_desktop: Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100, Agentic Browsing 100 (56/57 audits passed; Cumulative Layout Shift scored 0.99/1, well within the 'good' <0.1 threshold)
test_results.manual_browser_verification: Full Planner flow driven end-to-end via chrome-devtools MCP tools against a local static server: every result field checked against hand-computed expected values; explicit-confirm-before-send verified by patching window.open; Reset verified; Cancel verified to have zero side effects; all secondary pages checked for console errors; mobile viewport checked for overflow and hamburger-menu behaviour
